assets.name: Elongated Ego
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final standalone square portrait for Cancel City card game. Create NEW illustration; reference image is style guidance only. Match its grotesque punk underground comic art: thick energetic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, textured cheap paper, distressed vivid screen-printed colours, exaggerated confrontational face, detailed hand-drawn anatomy. Square full-bleed chest-up or tight waist-up composition, head dominates frame, instantly legible at thumbnail size. No card frame, border, UI, titles, readable lettering, logos or watermark. Rich detailed background with symbolic props. High resolution at least 1024 square. Subject: An unmistakably Elon Musk-inspired satirical cartoon, pale broad face, dark short side-parted hair, manic self-satisfied grin, intense wide eyes, black jacket, oversized head and small body. Riding a tiny shiny retro rocket while holding an absurdly large smartphone like a steering wheel; money-shaped sparks and chaotic neon-green jagged stock charts behind him. Purple and acid-lime backdrop, no Tesla/X/company logos, no readable text.
assets.inspection_notes: Inspected visually at full frame. Strong reference-matching black ink, crosshatching and distressed colour. Recognizable Elon-inspired comic face dominates square crop; rocket, oversized phone and jagged lime charts read clearly. No card frame, readable lettering, company logo or watermark. Both hands coherently grip phone. Bills use illustrative decoration without readable text.
